open_owner_items.fail_reading_dependence: OD1: binds only under reading (i), 25 mN as the upper edge of an operating window. Under reading (ii) (12 mN sustained floor plus 25 mN peak capability) a minimum stable thrust above 25 mN still complies, so its FAIL never makes G1 FAIL until the owner decides OD1.
open_owner_items.interpretation: Reading (i) of '12–25 mN' (OD1): the delivered thrust must be able to lie in the [12, 25] mN window, so an architecture whose minimum stable thrust exceeds 25 mN everywhere does not comply under that reading. It counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under both readings) but its FAIL is reported only (fail_reading_dependence). Whole-envelope coverage for both verdicts while OD2 is open.

open_owner_items.fail_reading_dependence: OD1: binds only under reading (ii), a 25 mN peak capability with Xe (R3 '25 mN peak with Xe topping'). Under reading (i) 25 mN is a cap, not a capability requirement.
open_owner_items.interpretation: Reading (ii). Reading (i) treats 25 mN as the upper edge of the operating window (docs/HISTORY.md mission sections: 'the RFP's 25 mN cap'). Counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under both readings) but its FAIL never makes G1 FAIL until the owner decides OD1.
Not counted toward G6 (neither PASS nor FAIL) until a threshold exists (OD5, OD14); listed as an open owner item that blocks milestone C.

open_owner_items.fail_reading_dependence: OD6: binds only under the 'feed switching' reading of 'air + Xe'.
open_owner_items.interpretation: One reading of 'air + Xe' (OD6). Counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under every reading) but its FAIL never makes G7 FAIL until the owner decides.

open_owner_items.fail_reading_dependence: OD6: binds only under the 'simultaneous mixed feed' reading of 'air + Xe' (linked to reading (ii) of OD1).
open_owner_items.interpretation: One reading of 'air + Xe' (OD6), linked to reading (ii) of '12–25 mN' (OD1). Counts toward PASS (a PASS must hold under every reading) but its FAIL never makes G7 FAIL until the owner decides.
